title: HostilePassives
body:
🐄 Hostile Passives

Turns friendly mobs into unexpected threats.

Hostile Passives is a simple but dangerous mod that makes peaceful mobs like Cows, Pigs, and even Villagers aggressive toward players. As soon as they spawn, they’ll seek you out and attack—no more free meat or safe farming.

Animals (Cows, Pigs, Sheep, etc.)

Water Animals (Cod, Salmon, etc.)

Villagers and Wandering Traders

Bees and other neutral mobs

📦 Mod Info

🧱 Minecraft: 1.21.1

🔧 Mod Loader: NeoForge

🪓 No configuration required

⚠️ Only affects vanilla mobs (not modded ones unless compatible)
